content: Awař n SIDI i dd-yusin i Ṣafanya, mmis n Kuci, mmis n Jadalya, mmis n Amarya, mmis n Ḥizqiya, deg wussan n Yuciya, mmis n Amun, ajeǧid n Yahuda.
Necc ad kkseɣ qaɛ marra min iǧan zeg wudem n temmurt, ammu i iqqar SIDI.
Ad kkseɣ bnadem d řmař, ad kkseɣ ijḍaḍ n ujenna d iseřman n řebḥar d tɛenkrifin ak-d iɛeffanen, wah Necc ad qḍiɣ bnadem x wudem n temmurt, ammu i iqqar SIDI.
Necc ad sswiẓẓḍeɣ s ufus inu ḍidd i Yahuda u ḍidd i marra imezdaɣ n Urcalim. Necc ad teḥḥiɣ min iqqimen zi Baɛl zeg wemcan-a ak-d yisem n ikehhanen n l’aṣnam,
d yinni isejden x tzeɣwin zzat i řɛeskar n ijenwan, u inni, am bendqen, jjuǧen ɣar SIDI, u aqa jjuǧen i Malkam,
uřa d yinni dd-ittɛaqqaben zi ḍeffar n SIDI, u yinni war arezzun x SIDI u war xas ttsseqsin.
Seɣd zzat i wudem n Sidi inu, SIDI, maɣar ass n SIDI yudes. SIDI aqa issewjed ict n tɣarṣt, Netta issqeddes imeɛraḍen nnes.
Ad imsar deg wass n tɣarṣt n SIDI, aqa Necc ad ɛaqbeɣ řḥukkam d iḥenjiren n ujeǧid d marra inni yarrḍen arruḍ aɣrib.
Deg wass nni ad ɛaqbeɣ marra inni ineggzen tanebdat, inni ittɛemmaren taddart n siditsen s lɛunf d řɣecc.
Deg wass nni, iqqar SIDI, ad din yiři ijj n řḥess n iɣuyyan zi Tewwart n Iseřman, uřa d řḥess n yinni ittrun zi tendint n jdid d ict n tareẓẓit temɣar zi tewririn.
Rum, imezdaɣ n jjihet n Umehraz, minzi marra isebbabben ttwaseɣḍen, marra inni iwezznen tmenyat ttwaqeḍɛen.
Di řweqt nni ad beqqceɣ di Urcalim s řeqnadeř, u Necc ad ɛaqbeɣ iryazen inni ittwagdaren zi řatar nni iqqimen n binu, inni iqqaren deg wuř nsen: ‘SIDI war ittegg řxar u war ittegg řɣar!’
Agřa nsen ad yiři i tkeccaḍt d tudrin nsen ad dewřent d řxarbet. Nitni ad bnan tudrin i yixef nsen, maca war daysent zeddɣen ca, nitni ad ẓẓun tizayarin, maca war sessen zi binu nnes.
Ass ameqqran n SIDI yudes, aqa-t yudes, deɣya yusa-dd. Řḥess n wass n SIDI! Ad isɣuy bu-teɣruḍt din s yict n tɣuyyit tarzeg.
Ass nni ad yiři d ass n uduqqez n ufugem, d ass n řeḥṣaret d ḍḍiqa, d ass n uxarreb d wareddeǧ, d ass n ṭṭřam d taǧest, d ass n iseynuten d useynu ibbumbes,
ijj n wass n usuḍi deg uyicc n icarri u n iɣuyyan n umenɣi ḍidd i tneddam ifaryen u ḍidd i ṣṣumɛat nni iǧan ɣar tɣemmura.
Necc ad ḥṣareɣ iwdan u nitni ad uyuren am yidarɣařen, minzi nitni ggin ddenb x SIDI. Idammen nsen ad ttwazeǧɛen amecnaw tɛejjajt, d weysum nsen amecnaw ixxan.

Uřa d nnuqart nsen d wureɣ nsen war zemmaren ad ten ssnejmen deg wass n uduqqez n ufugem n SIDI. Timessi n tusmi nnes iqeddsen ad tecc marra tammurt, maɣar deɣya Netta ad iqḍa marra imezdaɣ n temmurt.

footnotes.text: Ṣafanya- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘wenni t issnuffaren SIDI’.
